lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Rated the current head (cc096b3 plus the integration commits; build /tmp/claude-0/b/test.html 14:02, renders /tmp/claude-0/r6 14:03-14:08). Extra studio shots at the reference camera angles are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB6/r (f_level = y_47300 level frontal, f_302 = y_47302 3/4 view, b_sans15 = sans 15 seated rear view, h_side = headrest side, a_303 = y_47303 top view). Scale: f_level and y_47300 both give about 300 px/m from the 19 in (0.483 m) seat spacing, so widths compare directly. In-service photos (SANspotter NH107 2023 set, flight-report 57325 JA794A 2022) win on geometry; ANA photos win on colour.

priorIssues.evidence: SEATMAT.yFabricD + tex_y_fleck, about 40 % of seats via econFab. q15 front-row fleck back: L50 37, p90/p50 2.11, 18 % bright, flecks #5a618b on #191e48 (ratio 3.0). y_47300 seat 4: L50 46, p90/p50 1.91, 15.7 % bright, #6b799f on #152349 (ratio 3.4). The statistics match. What remains is the distribution: the swatch's flecks clump, where the photo's are evenly spaced (see w6b-5).

issues.title: Diamond fabric still reads as a navy trellis on lavender (figure and ground inverted)
issues.evidence: Otsu light-area / hi-lo: e4 0.44 / 1.36, q15 0.47 / 1.44, f_level 0.45 / 1.31. y_47306 left seat 0.19 / 1.90, y_47302 middle seat 0.07 / 1.99. raterB6/diamond_cmp.png (photo | render | swatch). issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond(): keep the 18 centres and the 5 mm steps, but shrink the half-diagonals from 0.026/0.022 to 0.019/0.016 m (light area about 0.16). Quiet the ground so the ticks don't join the figure: before mixing, set t = t.mean + 0.4 * (t - t.mean) for the (1 - m) part. Raise lift from (2.0, 1.8, 1.4) to (2.5, 2.2, 1.7) so the blocks keep hi/lo of about 1.9. Re-run make_swatches.py for y_diamond only and check Otsu on e4 (target 0.15-0.22, hi/lo 1.8-2.0).

issues.title: Headrest cushion does not read as a separate pad; cover slightly wide
issues.evidence: f_level row scan at cover height: cover 85 px (0.28 m), back plus wings 122 px (0.41 m), white gap of 25 px (0.083 m) between seats. y_47300 at the same scale: cover 69-73 px (0.23 m), back 138 px (0.44 m), gap 6-10 px. In y_47300 the cushion's rounded outline sits inside a visible margin of back fabric. In the render the wings run into the back edges, with no undercut. In h_side the angled hem (gRBox 0.27 x 0.04, -20 deg) reads as a shelf under the cover.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat: (a) back loft: widen the top sections. SEC(0.70) w 0.40 -> 0.42, SEC(0.818) 0.39 -> 0.41, SEC(0.838) 0.382 -> 0.40, SEC(0.853) 0.361 -> 0.375. (b) Headrest loft: replace the first section with an undercut, SEC(0.60, 0.33, 0.06, -0.035, 0.028) -> SEC(0.605, 0.30, 0.03, -0.02, 0.012), so there is a shadow line under the pad. (c) Cover plate, fold and hem width 0.27 -> 0.25. Hem gRBox(0.27, 0.04, 0.005, ...) at -20 deg -> gRBox(0.25, 0.03, 0.003, 0.002, 1) at -8 deg. Mirror (c) in econUnitFar (gBox 0.27 -> 0.25).

issues.title: Petal flecks clump instead of being evenly spread
issues.evidence: raterB6/fleck_cmp2.png: y_47300 seat 4 flecks are blue-noise spaced, about 6-8 x 3 mm. tex_y_fleck uses uniform random placement, so it forms visible clusters and voids (h_side, q15 seat 4 reads as 'TV static' at row distance). Global stats already match (see priorIssues).
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_fleck(): place flecks by Poisson-disc (dart throwing with a minimum centre spacing of about 4.5 mm on the 0.2 m tile, wrapped at the edges) at the same count (about 12 % cover). Keep the size and lift.

issues.title: Pillow too narrow, too light, too rigid
issues.evidence: f_level pillow 0.35 m wide (0.72 of the seat spacing), against y_47300 0.81 and sans 14 about 0.83 of the pan. q15 L50 59 against y_47300 44. The shading is uniform (p90/p50 1.14 against 1.36): no seams or sag.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow: 0.175 * X -> 0.195 * X and 0.12 * Z -> 0.13 * Z. Lean it back: rotation -80 -> -72 deg, and move it to z -0.09. Add a sag, g.p[k+1] += -0.01 * (1 - Z * Z) * X * X, for a soft middle. 09_seats.js SEATMAT.yPillow '#4d5579' -> '#3e4565'.

issues.title: Back-top band seen from behind still about 2x the photo

issues.title: Pocket net opaque; pictogram placard blank
issues.evidence: e6 and b_sans15 show a uniform dark band, where sans 20 and 23 show a see-through mesh. The tray placard is a plain pale quad (e5, at the tray's left), where sans 15 shows black seat-recline pictograms.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: net gRBox depth 0.014 -> 0.004, colour '#2a2c31' -> '#3a3d44', with LAYER.grille kept. If the Builder supports alpha, use a gQuad with a = 0.55. Placard: add an atlas tile 'ypicto' (06_atlas.js, integrator) or two small dark quads gQuad(0.012, 0.012) inside it.

issues.title: Fabric pattern smears on 45-degree faces (back top roll, seat-back sides) - lighting/shader owner
issues.evidence: q17 foreground seats show stretched white streaks on the top roll. b_sans15 left seat side shows smeared diagonal streaks. The cause is the triplanar blend w = pow(abs(N), 4) in 04_shaders.js, which mixes two projections at about 50/50 on these faces.
issues.fix: 04_shaders.js (lighting owner): for photo layers (layer >= 16), sharpen the blend, w = pow(abs(N), vec3(10.0)). Or bias the seat backs to the z projection. Econ cannot fix this locally.

issues.title: q15 camera does not match y_47300 (QA harness)
issues.evidence: q15 walk(0, 1.62, 46.05, pi, -0.42) looks down 24 deg. y_47300 is near level from about headrest height, so q15 exaggerates the cover and hides the pans and pillows.

questionsForUser: Seat-belt webbing: in-service photos (fr57325 124108, JA794A) and ANA's y_47302 show charcoal; ANA's y_47303 shows mid blue. Is your NH7/NH8 aircraft charcoal or blue?

Headrest cover width: ANA's y_47300 shows covers about 0.6 of the cushion, while in-service sans 13 looks closer to 0.8 (wide-angle, so unreliable). Do you have a straight-on photo of an occupied-row headrest?

Fabric mix: the in-service photos (sans 12 / 13, fr57325) show mostly petal-fleck and diamond seats, with tick seats rare. Should the cabin follow ANA's showroom mix (all four patterns roughly evenly) or the in-service look?
